source: docs/copenhagen-d1/published-network.json (Wikipedia Copenhagen Metro station list + station infoboxes, hand-transcribed 30 Aug 2026). Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds baked in here (none in the D1 pack) - the adapter resolves Rejseplanen GTFS stop_ids at request time by name match (lib/providers/gtfs/static-cache.js findRailStopIdsForName), same runtime-resolution pattern as lib/providers/malmo.js resolveStopIds(). Verify the resolved stop_ids against a live Rejseplanen payload before any flip.

stations.name: Nørreport
stations.note: Three-way doNotGroup: Metro (M1, M2) vs S-tog (six lines) vs DSB/Öresundståg (Kystbanen platform). Widest single-node surface - hazard-pack.md H2. Öresundståg inclusion here is flagged for Tim confirmation, not settled (direction-model-memo.md open question 4).

stations.name: Kongens Nytorv
stations.note: Locked Metro-only hub - all four lines, confirmed zero rail/S-tog transfer. Never a direction token.

stations.name: København H
stations.note: Four-way doNotGroup: Metro (M3, M4) vs S-tog (six lines) vs DSB/Öresundståg vs EuroCity (excluded, out-reservation, never rendered). SJ (Stockholm) and České dráhy (Prague) also call here but are unverdicted for board-eligibility - not included, not excluded, flagged for Nico/Tim (hazard-pack.md H3).

stations.name: Nørrebro
stations.note: Two-way doNotGroup: Metro (M3) vs S-tog F (Ring Line) only. Simplest shared station - no DSB/Öresundståg here.

stations.name: Orientkaj
stations.note: M4 terminus. Harbour bus (Havnebus 991/992) connection is out-mode, excluded.

stations.name: Nordhavn
stations.note: Two-way doNotGroup: Metro (M4) vs S-tog (A, B, Bx, C, E - NOT H, hazard-pack.md H2 correction). One shared S-train island platform, five lines - keep the line letter as the primary token on every row, never collapse to a bare neighbour-station direction.

stations.name: Havneholmen
stations.note: M4-only, not M3, despite sitting near the M3 ring's western arc.

stations.name: København S
stations.note: Renamed 2024 (was Ny Ellebjerg St.). M4 southern terminus. Has its own S-train/regional interchange per the Metro station-list, but is NOT one of the four named shared stations - out of doNotGroup scope here (see published-network.json coverageGaps).
